page.layout: One column of city lines below the running head; at the foot, a signature at left and a catchword at right.

main_text.l: Prima Provincia Germaniae habet civitates numero II. Metropolis civitas Agrippina, id est Colonia.
Secunda Provincia habet civitates numero VIII.
Civitas Augusta Vindelicum, id est Auuerpurch.
Provincia Bataviorum, id est Noricum Ripense super Danubium, sive Norisum Mediterraneum habet civitates numero VI.
Metropolis civitas Iuuauo, id est Salzburg.
Provincia Sequanorum habet civitates numero VII.
Provincia Alpium Penninitarum habet civitates numero III[?].
Metropolis civitas Centronium, id est Darantasia.
Provincia Meninsis habet civitates numero X.
Civitas Carpentoratensis, quae nunc Vitasca dicitur.

page.notes: The running head and the page number are printed at the top; the page number is "123" in the scan. The "numero" value for the Alpine province is badly blurred ("ri."), so I marked it as uncertain. The signature "LL ij" is partly illegible. Several place names have worn or faint letters (e.g. Atrauitum, Morinum, Carpentoratensis), and the scan shows a dark stain across the middle of the text block that obscures some letters.
